## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue and state any migration or rollback requirement.

## 1. What would you do differently?

Explain design, naming, structure, and readability decisions or remaining improvements.

## 2. Coupling

Identify affected module boundaries, dependency direction, and contracts.

## 3. DRY

Describe shared logic extracted or explain why similar behavior remains separate.

## 4. Vulnerabilities

Describe changes to authorization, input validation, private data, dependencies, or trust boundaries. Distinguish verified findings from untested risks.

## Validation

List relevant checks and results. State any unverified behavior or environment limitation.
